title: What Should We Fix First?
instructions: These came out of last sprint's retro. Pick the ones you think we should take on first and put them in priority order — your ranking helps us decide what to commit to. Then add one idea of your own that the list is missing.

options.text: fix the flaky tests before adding features
cut the build time in half
pair more often, especially on unfamiliar code
retire the two services nobody owns
